meta.title: Online Notepad - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Browser-based notepad with auto-save to localStorage, Markdown preview, and PDF/TXT export. No account needed.
notepadConfirmNew: Discard current content and start a new document?
steps_online-notepad_1Desc: Begin writing in the editor — your content auto-saves to browser localStorage every 500ms. Close the tab and come back — your notes persist.
steps_online-notepad_2Desc: Format with Markdown syntax (headings, bold, lists, code). Toggle Preview mode to see rendered output. Switch between dark and light editor themes.
steps_online-notepad_3Desc: Download your notes as a .txt file or export to PDF with automatic word wrapping. No account needed — everything stays on your device.
